mapper.select: SELECT db_im_group.id, db_im_group.group_id, db_im_group.owner_id, db_im_group.name, db_im_group.notification, db_im_group.member_count, db_im_group.status, db_im_group.create_time, db_im_group.update_time, db_im_group.is_deleted FROM db_im_group INNER JOIN db_im_group_member ON db_im_group_member.group_id = db_im_group.group_id WHERE db_im_group_member.user_id = #{userId} AND db_im_group.is_deleted = 0 AND db_im_group_member.is_deleted = 0
